front.title: Secure Reporting of SUIT Update Status

abstract.t: This document defines a Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) format for reporting the results of processing a Software Update for the Internet of Things (SUIT) manifest. Reports can include diagnostic records, measured system properties, and supported capabilities. Using a report and the corresponding manifest, a developer can reconstruct the decisions made and actions performed by a manifest processor during update or boot processing. The document also specifies protection of reports using CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) and their use in remote attestation.
